title: Platform-and-mechanism vocabulary map (wave 0)
description: The survey's search protocol, not a glossary. It mints the platform slugs ONCE — the record id is <platform_slug>__<angle_id>, so a slug invented independently by two angles produces two rows for one platform and the dedupe never fires.

slug.description: Minted here and adopted VERBATIM by every angle. Lowercase kebab-case.

retrieved_at.description: When THIS agent produced the map. Assertable on our own authority — distinct from as_of, which is a property of the world.

revision.description: Increments on every revise round; a protocol is never silently rewritten.

platforms.description: The slug registry. Every downstream candidate MUST carry a slug from this list; an angle that mints its own breaks the dedupe silently.

platform_type.description: The capability-map vocabulary verbatim. `none` is absent deliberately: a platform typed `none` is not a comparable.

why_comparable.description: Why this platform is evidence FOR THIS project. A slug with no stated comparability is a platform someone recognised, not one they justified.

mechanisms.description: The mechanism vocabulary the angles search on — the second half of the <platform>__<angle> record unit.

expansions.description: SKOS-style: the terms a platform may use for the same mechanism. Different vendors name one thing five ways.

angle_applicability.description: One verdict per angle, INCLUDING the ones that do not hold. An angle that never ran and an angle that ran and found nothing are different facts, and only a recorded verdict distinguishes them before the search wave starts.

excluded.description: Platforms considered and deliberately left out, each with its reason. Silent omission and considered exclusion look identical downstream.

sources.description: The registry rows this map actually consulted, by id.
